headline: Nigerian Opposition Demands Detailed Accounting for $20.5 Billion Loan Plan
summary: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar has urged President Bola Tinubu to publish project-by-project breakdowns of a proposed $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion external borrowing program, citing transparency concerns.
why: Nigeria's external debt portfolio directly affects sovereign credit ratings, debt servicing costs, and foreign exchange reserves.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Public and political scrutiny of massive foreign borrowing plans could influence sovereign borrowing terms.
